articles.title: The footballer-turned-BookTuber who made an obscure Tolstoy novella a belated bestseller
articles.dek: Once named the best player in Brazil, Gustavo Scarpa’s literature obsession has inspired thousands to become bookworms Julián Scatolaro noticed something odd was…
articles.description: Once named the best player in Brazil, Gustavo Scarpa’s literature obsession has inspired thousands to become bookworms Julián Scatolaro noticed something odd was occurring when several people came into his bookshop over the space of a few days, all asking for Leo Tolstoy’s novella The Death of Ivan Ilyich . The 35-year-old, who owns a bookshop in the small Argentine city of Chajarí, 311 miles from Buenos Aires, said the sudden interest in a book written in 1886 was surprising enough. But this was particularly strange because when his customers ask for works by the Russian writer, they usually want War and Peace . In a video he posted about the mystery, he called it the “ Tolstoy enigma ”. Continue reading...
